newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan share prices seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan share prices seen consolidating.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were expected to consolidate on Tuesday following Monday's 3.72 percent plunge but jitters over politics would continue to dampen market sentiment, brokers said.
On Monday, the weighted index finished down 307.55 points or 3.72 percent to 7,966.64, breaking the longstanding technical and psychological support of 8,000 points.

Opposition lawmakers' plan to demand that President Lee Teng-hui undertake a more sweeping cabinet reshuffle and sack Premier Lien, whom Lee has been grooming as his successor, would be the market focus today, brokers said.
"It will be a big blow to the market if the opposition parties succeed in passing their motion," said Wang Jieh, an analyst of Foremost Investment Services.
"Local politics will likely head for a more uncertain direction," he added.
But some brokers said government-related funds are likely to enter and support the market.
A range of 7,850-8,100 was seen for Tuesday.
